stable versus RC ordering and first-equal ties

limitations: Known small regression fixtures; no general reliability, speed or model-superiority claim.
Adaptive changes between recorded runs and pilots; all failures are retained.
The stronger-guidance experiment stopped after two failures, retaining one interrupted and three unstarted cases; it was not a completed six-case validation.
Latest release and join validation comes from separate fixed runs with matching runtime/profile/limits and the current task fingerprints; it is not a new six-case run.
Expanded public tests change task fingerprints. Results are not matched pairs with earlier fixtures.
No concurrent control arm; effects of guidance, review context, public checks and model choice are not isolated.
The Qwen35 and Gemma 8192-output experiments are distinct from the 4096-output runs; their controls and outcomes are recorded separately.
Every run retains the 300-second task deadline and 16-call cap.
Local API cost excludes hardware and electricity. Native signing is local/ad-hoc.
